592450.summary: Aaron Judge developed from a multi-sport high school athlete in Linden, California, into a Fresno State standout, a first-round Yankees selection, and one of the defining power hitters of his era.

education.details: Played baseball, football, and basketball before choosing college baseball.
Played three baseball seasons and earned repeated all-conference recognition before entering professional baseball.

timeline.label: Completed high school
timeline.details: Graduated from Linden High School after competing in three sports.

timeline.label: Began Fresno State career
timeline.details: Started a three-season college career with the Bulldogs.

timeline.label: Drafted by New York Yankees
timeline.details: Selected in the first round with the 32nd overall pick.

timeline.label: Major League debut
timeline.details: Debuted for the New York Yankees.

timeline.label: Fresno State jersey retired
timeline.details: Fresno State retired Judge's No. 29 jersey.

660271.summary: Shohei Ohtani emerged from Iwate Prefecture and Hanamaki Higashi High School, became a professional two-way star in Japan, and then continued as both a hitter and pitcher in Major League Baseball.

education.details: Played in major Japanese national high school tournaments before entering professional baseball.

timeline.label: Born
timeline.details: Born in Oshu, Iwate Prefecture, Japan.

timeline.label: National high school tournament
timeline.details: Participated in Japan's National High School Baseball Championship with Hanamaki Higashi.

timeline.label: Completed high school baseball path
timeline.details: Participated in the National High School Baseball Invitational Tournament and entered professional baseball in Japan.

timeline.label: Professional debut in Japan
timeline.details: Began his professional career with the Hokkaido Nippon-Ham Fighters.

timeline.label: Signed with Los Angeles Angels
timeline.details: Signed as an international free agent to begin his Major League career.

timeline.label: Major League debut
timeline.details: Made his MLB debut as a two-way player.

694973.summary: Paul Skenes moved from El Toro High School to the U.S. Air Force Academy and LSU, developing as a two-way college player before becoming an elite pitcher and the first overall selection in the 2023 MLB Draft.

education.details: Three-year letterwinner, team captain, and high-achieving student.
Completed two years as a cadet and excelled as a two-way baseball player before transferring.
Majored in interdisciplinary studies and helped LSU win the 2023 College World Series.

timeline.label: Graduated from El Toro High School
timeline.details: Completed high school after serving as a baseball team captain.

timeline.label: Entered Air Force Academy
timeline.details: Began a two-year Air Force baseball and cadet-development experience.

timeline.label: Transferred to LSU
timeline.details: Transferred after two seasons at the Air Force Academy.

timeline.label: National championship and first overall pick
timeline.details: Won the College World Series with LSU and was selected first overall by Pittsburgh.

timeline.label: Major League debut
timeline.details: Made his MLB debut for the Pittsburgh Pirates.
